diagnostics_description: This is composed from what the kernel knows about the failure. Read it before posting — you can edit it here, and this is the last check before it reaches a public issue.
diagnostics_full_warning: The full level keeps the log and stack at full length and leaves paths intact. Credentials are still masked, but read the text before posting it.
diagnostics_kernel_unreachable: The kernel did not answer, so this carries only what the browser knows: no log, no install receipt, and no secret masking.

denied_unanswered.title: {{n}} command(s) denied: the request closed without an answer

expires_soon.title: The hub access token expires soon
expires_soon.body: It expires on {{date}}. Renew it in Settings → Security to keep receiving updates for {{n}} restricted connector(s). Installed connectors are not affected.

expired.title: The hub access token has expired
expired.body: Restricted connectors can no longer be updated. Installed ones keep working. An expired token cannot be renewed; ask for a new one to be issued on the hub and set it in Settings → Security.

refused.title: The hub refused this kernel's access token
refused.body: Restricted connectors are hidden from the catalog and cannot be updated until a valid token is set in Settings → Security. Installed ones keep working.

permission_needed.title: '{{server}}' needs the '{{permission}}' capability
permission_needed.body: The server is blocked from starting until this is granted or denied.
